profile.Name: Cyber Beep
profile.Personality: Nervous, simple, and eager. He wants to grow strong and become a swordsman, and after any win he crows that he is the strongest warrior. He takes figures of speech literally.
profile.Backstory: His hive exiled him, and he has nothing: no weapon and no skills. He hangs around the Mechanical Hive Village and follows strangers about.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Says 'Beep!' constantly, more so when nervous, and talks about himself in the third person: 'Beep is the strongest!' He greets Skeletons with 'Ho, fellow skeleton!' and insists that Beep is a skeleton too.
